_about: The demo of the mentoring template: a mentor and a new team lead. Read by server/demo-loader.js, which writes it through the real module routes; the format is described in templates/demo/travel.json and the loader. Its phases are measured by goals. Dates are offsets: "start" is the next check-in (today plus "anchor" days).
label: Mentoring demo
name: Demo: Zoe and Omar
description: A first year as a team lead, with a mentor: goals, next steps, check-ins and a meeting log. Reset by running it again.

# Meeting log

## Check-in 4

**What we talked about:** the new one-to-one format is working; two people asked for more time on what they are stuck on. Feedback is the next thing to practise.

**Agreed next steps:**

- Zoe writes two real situations for a role-play.
- Zoe asks the team three short questions about the new format.
- Omar shares the notes on situation, behaviour, impact.

text:mlogzoe1:mlogzoc1.text:
# Meeting log

## Check-in 4

**What we talked about:** the new one-to-one format is working; two people asked for more time on what they are stuck on. Feedback is the next thing to practise.

**Agreed next steps:**

- Zoe writes two real situations for a role-play.
- Zoe asks the team three short questions about the new format.
- Omar shares the notes on situation, behaviour, impact.

## Check-in 3

**What we talked about:** Friday afternoon one-to-ones get cancelled. Sitting in on Omar's team meeting.

**Agreed next steps:**

- Move the Friday one-to-ones.
- Zoe sits in on Omar's team meeting.

## Check-in 2

**What we talked about:** what Zoe wants from this year: better one-to-ones, clear feedback, and a quarter plan the team owns.

**Agreed next steps:**

- Put the three goals in the Development plan.
- Ask each person what a good one-to-one is for them.

## Check-in 1

**What we talked about:** how we work together. Every two weeks, 45 minutes, notes here.

messages.text: Hi Zoe. Next check-in is in two days. Anything you want on the agenda?
Feedback. I have one I keep putting off.
Good, that is what the role-plays are for. Bring it, names changed.
The one-to-ones are better. Two people said they finally get time on what they are stuck on.

> finally get time on what they are stuck on
That is the whole point. Well done.
I ticked the Friday one off. Two moved to the morning, one is now a walk.
Getting started is done, and one-to-ones are three of four.
I shared a short guide on situation, behaviour, impact in Research.
Read it on the train. The "leave out what you think they meant" part is hard.
It is. We will practise exactly that.
I wrote up last time in the Meeting log.
Thanks. See you on the check-in.
